mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion, which increases loperamide's CNS penetration and risk of adverse effects including potential QT prolongation; loperamide may also worsen dehydration-induced electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antidiarrheal agents; assess QT interval if patient has cardiac risk factors.
